chapters.label: The screamer, live
chapters.text: Stamford Bridge, the Champions League semi-final. Clàudia Pina is trapped near her own box, but slips a pass to Aitana Bonmatí, and sprints forward. Bonmatí races up the pitch, two against two. The ball finds Pina. She curls it... into the far corner!

chapters.label: Calm under pressure
chapters.text: Watch again. Four Chelsea players close in. Pina stays calm, and threads it with the outside of her foot.

chapters.label: Hard and true
chapters.text: She strikes it hard and true, bending it past Hannah Hampton!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Lock your ankle and strike through the ball, so it flies hard and true.
